name: PaperPath: PDF Sign & Redact
subtitle: Offline OCR, forms & signing
promotionalText: Sign it. Review private details. Check the copy you share. A local PDF workflow for iPhone and iPad, with one purchase and no subscription.
description:
Your PDF. Ready to leave your hands.

Fill a form, add your signature, review private details, and check the copy you share. PaperPath brings the document workflow together on iPhone and iPad, with core PDF processing and text recognition on your device.

FILL. SIGN. FINISH.
Read and annotate PDFs, fill supported interactive forms, and place a handwritten signature. Reorder pages, combine documents, and create a smaller copy when compression helps. Work on a private copy while keeping the source file you imported.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU SHARE
Scan for supported types of sensitive information on device. Open each candidate in context, decide what to remove, and create a permanently redacted copy. Automatic detection can miss information; review the document before sharing.

MAKE SCANS SEARCHABLE
Capture and review pages, adjust crop and contrast, and recognize text locally. Review uncertain text and correct recognition results before creating a searchable PDF.

CHECK THE COPY YOU SEND
Verified Output creates a separate image-based PDF, reopens its pages, and records file checks in a receipt. Review warnings and source/output information, then share the checked PDF or a package containing the PDF and receipt.

This output is flattened: searchable text, links, interactive forms, and editable layers are removed from that copy. File checks do not certify content accuracy, a signer's identity, or legal compliance. Handwritten signatures are visual marks.

LOCAL AT THE CORE
No PaperPath account is required. PDF processing, OCR, and privacy detection run on device. Optional iCloud metadata sync does not back up your PDFs. Sharing through other apps follows the services you choose.

ONE PURCHASE
Pay once to download PaperPath. No subscription or in-app feature unlocks.

KEEP IMPORTANT FILES
The private document library is excluded from automatic device backups. Export important files to Files or another location before deleting the app or changing devices.
